rows.title: General Updates
rows.summary: In continuation of our earlier intimations dated March 18, 2026 and March 27, 2026, and pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations, we wish to inform you that the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka has, on May 12, 2026, pronounced an order in favour of Embassy East Business Park Limited ("EEBPL"), a subsidiary of the Company, by allowing the writ petition filed by EEBPL and setting aside the order dated March 16, 2026, passed by the KIADB, which had directed resumption of the land admeasuring approximately 78 acres situated at Kadugodi Industrial Area, Bengaluru Urban District ("Land"), held by EEBPL ("KIADB Order").For more details, please refer attached intimation.

rows.title: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
rows.summary: The Hon ble NCLAT has, today i.e. May 4, 2026, pronounced its order in favour of the Company, allowing its appeal, and accordingly:(i) The Hon ble NCLAT has set aside the impugned order dated December 9, 2025, passed by the Hon ble National Company Law Tribunal, New Delhi Bench ( NCLT ), which had admitted the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process ( CIRP ) against the Company under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 ( IBC );(ii) The interim protection granted earlier by the Hon ble NCLAT stands subsumed into the final order;(iii) The CIRP initiated against the Company stands quashed and closed; and(iv) All directions arising pursuant to the said NCLT order stand terminated and disposed of.In view of the above, the Company is no longer subject to CIRP and stands relieved from the insolvency proceedings.For more details, please refer attachment.
